correctness.rationale: The exact Dirichlet quartic contraction gives Q=(1+c)/2+(1+c)H/T²+3cW/T². Positive covariance eigenvalues and vertex radius Cauchy inequalities yield the nonnegative exact lower-remainder identity; isotropic Gram forces regular simplex. The scalar zero-sum quartic lemma is proved by two-valued maximizers, then Cauchy gives W<=k_n T², yielding a strict upper bound since covariance has rank >=2. Explicit nondegenerate rank-one collapsing families attain the supremum in the limit and the continuous axial deformation realizes every interior value. The extracted standard-library checker ran 90001 exact rational diagnostic assertions; finite tests do not prove quantifiers.
